paper_title: How to Generate Popular Post Headlines on Social Media
caption: The average similarities between the headlines from different seasons
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the difference in days (Δ Days) and average similarity. The x-axis is labeled “Δ Days” and displays values in intervals of 90, ranging from (0,90] to (360,450]. The x-axis has five tick labels: (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450]. The y-axis is labeled “Avg. similarity (10e-2)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 1.70 to 1.85 with numerical values displayed. A single blue dashed line with circular markers traces a trend across the x-axis; starting at approximately 1.82 at (0,90], it declines to approximately 1.77 at (180,270], then increases to approximately 1.79 at (360,450]. There is a peak at approximately 1.82 at (0,90], a decline to approximately 1.74 at (270,360] before increasing once again. A shaded region surrounds the line, representing variability.
